source: apple-importer; records what the Apple app does today, NOT a target
notes: The same text with CRLF line endings (a file saved by Windows Notepad).

Apple misses every marker that has no colon (the line ends in a carriage return), leaves CR characters inside the stored text, and the code block never closes when the message is displayed. The web app must return exactly the result of the LF fixture.

messages.text: Exported chat about a wobbling wheel.

display_segments.text: Exported chat about a wobbling wheel.

messages.text: My rear wheel wobbles. What should I check first?

display_segments.text: My rear wheel wobbles. What should I check first?

messages.text:
Check the spoke tension first.
Spin the wheel and watch the gap at the brake pads.

## Human
The gap changes near the valve.

### Claude
Tighten the two spokes opposite the wobble by a quarter turn:

```sh
spoke-key --turn 0.25 --spokes 7,9
```
